patch.title: Sync methods.tex question numbering (Q1/Q2) and per-question scale descriptions with survey.tex

hunks.oldText: We used a five-level scale and analyzed Question 1 and Question 2.
hunks.newText: Both Q1 and Q2 used a five-level scale: Q1 measured satisfaction (1 = Very dissatisfied to 5 = Very satisfied), and Q2 measured likelihood to recommend (1 = Definitely no to 5 = Definitely yes). We analyzed Q1 and Q2.
